title: Contractor Ply Pain to VAJRA PP Solution

segments.vo: Har kuch slab pe naya ply mangwana padta hai?
Bhari ply uthane mein do mazdoor lagte hain.
Site par patakne se ply jaldi kharab hoti hai.
Apne thekedar ko bhejo, aur ply badal kar chuno VAJRA PP sheet.

end_vo: Comment mein PP likhiye, follow kijiye, rate aapke DM mein.
caption:
Har kuch slab pe naya ply khareedne ka jhanjhat chhodie.
VAJRA PP shuttering sheet hai waterproof aur sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.
Har dhalai ka kharcha kam kijiye aur site par kaam aasan banaiye.
Comment mein PP likhiye, follow kijiye, rate aapke DM mein.
Follow kijiye @vajraformwork | Call/WhatsApp: 83050 70160
